license_required.quote: Unless licensed pursuant to the Optometry Act, or specifically exempted or excluded from the application of all or part of that act, a person shall not: A. practice optometry

type.quote: There is created a six-member "board of optometry"

umbrella_agency.quote: The board shall be administratively attached to the regulation and licensing department

age_minimum.quote: has reached the age of majority

degree_required.quote: has graduated and been awarded a doctor of optometry degree from a school or college of optometry approved and accredited by the board

accrediting_body.quote: approved and accredited by the board

exams.name: Board Examination
exams.quote: An applicant meeting the qualifications set forth in Section 61-2-8 NMSA 1978 for initial licensure shall file an application under oath on forms supplied by the board for an examination by the board

exams.name: Pharmaceutical Agents Examination
exams.quote: Applicants for licensure shall meet the requirements for certification in the use of pharmaceutical agents as set forth in the Optometry Act and shall successfully complete the board's examination in pharmaceutical agents prior to licensure

interval_years.quote: A license shall be renewed annually on or before July 1

available.quote: No later than thirty days after an out-of-state licensee files an application for an expedited license, the board shall process the application and issue an expedited license in accordance with Section 61-1-31.1 NMSA 1978

requirements.value: Out-of-state licensee must hold current and good standing license; board may require examination if prior jurisdiction did not require one
requirements.quote: If the board issues an expedited license to a person whose prior licensing jurisdiction did not require examination, the board may require the person to pass an examination before applying for license renewal

exists.quote: There is created a six-member "board of optometry"

regulatory_model.quote: Unless licensed pursuant to the Optometry Act, or specifically exempted or excluded from the application of all or part of that act, a person shall not: A. practice optometry

credential_type.quote: Each applicant for a license to practice optometry as provided in Chapter 61, Article 2 NMSA 1978 who successfully passes the examination for licensure, possesses the required educational qualifications and meets other requirements of the Optometry Act or regulations adopted pursuant to that act is entitled to a license that carries with it the title "doctor of optometry"

is_mandatory.quote: Unless licensed pursuant to the Optometry Act, or specifically exempted or excluded from the application of all or part of that act, a person shall not: A. practice optometry

title_protection.quote:
a person shall not:
A. practice optometry;
B. represent himself or offer his services as being able to practice optometry; or
C. duplicate or replace an ophthalmic lens.

scope_protection.quote: a person shall not: A. practice optometry

disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a felony, as shown by a certified copy of the record of the court of conviction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continued practice with infectious or contagious disease
disciplinary_grounds.quote: continued practice by a person knowingly having an infectious or contagious disease

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising by false, misleading or deceptive statements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: advertising by means of knowingly false, misleading or deceptive statements or advertising or attempting to practice under a name other than one's own

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual drunkenness or addiction to habit-forming drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: habitual drunkenness or addiction to the use of habit-forming drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting unlicensed practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: aiding or abetting in the practice of optometry any person not duly licensed to practice optometry in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Lending, leasing or placing license at disposal of unlicensed person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: lending, leasing or in any other manner placing his certificate of license at the disposal or in the service of any person not licensed to practice optometry in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or inducing unlicensed person to practice optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: employing, procuring or inducing an unlicensed person to practice optometry in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating provisions of the Optometry Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violating any of the provisions of the Optometry Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined by board regulation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: committing any act defined as "unprofessional conduct" by regulation of the board filed in accordance with the State Rules Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct tending to deceive or defraud the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any conduct of a character tending to deceive or defraud the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining fee by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the obtaining of a fee by fraud or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging unusual, unreasonable or exorbitant fees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: charging unusual, unreasonable or exorbitant fees

disciplinary_grounds.description: Splitting or dividing a fee with any person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: "splitting" or dividing a fee with any person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising or granting discount for professional services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: advertising by any means, or granting, a discount for professional services, prosthetic devices, eyeglasses, lenses, frames or mountings whether sold separately or as part of the professional services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Price advertising implying reduced or no cost services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: using any type of "price advertising" which would tend to imply the furnishing of professional services without cost or at a reduced cost to the public

definition_quote.value: the employment of any subjective or objective means or methods, including but not limited to the use of lenses, prisms, autorefractors or other automated testing devices, and includes the prescription or administration of drugs for the purpose of diagnosing the visual defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa; the employing, adapting or prescribing of preventive or corrective measures, including but not limited to lenses, prisms, contact or corneal lenses or other optical appliances, ocular exercises, vision therapy, vision training and vision rehabilitation services, and includes the prescription or administration of all drugs rational for the correction, relief or referral of visual defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa
definition_quote.quote: "practice of optometry" means: (1) the employment of any subjective or objective means or methods, including but not limited to the use of lenses, prisms, autorefractors or other automated testing devices, and includes the prescription or administration of drugs for the purpose of diagnosing the visual defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa; (2) the employing, adapting or prescribing of preventive or corrective measures, including but not limited to lenses, prisms, contact or corneal lenses or other optical appliances, ocular exercises, vision therapy, vision training and vision rehabilitation services, and includes the prescription or administration of all drugs rational for the correction, relief or referral of visual defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa

value: prescription of lenses and optical appliances
methods_authorized.quote: the employment of any subjective or objective means or methods, including but not limited to the use of lenses, prisms, autorefractors or other automated testing devices, and includes the prescription or administration of drugs

drug_authority.value: Optometrists qualified and certified by the board may prescribe or administer all pharmaceutical agents for the diagnosis and treatment of disease of the eye or adnexa, subject to restrictions on controlled substances
drug_authority.quote: optometrists qualified and certified by the board may prescribe or administer all pharmaceutical agents for the diagnosis and treatment of disease of the eye or adnexa; provided that an optometrist: (1) may prescribe hydrocodone and hydrocodone combination medications; (2) may administer epinephrine auto-injections to counter anaphylaxis; and (3) shall not prescribe any other controlled substance classified in Schedule I or II

surgery_prohibited.quote: does not include the use of surgery or injections in the treatment of eye diseases except for the use of the following types of in-office minor surgical procedures

surgery_definition.value: Surgery is prohibited except for specific in-office minor surgical procedures including non-laser removal of superficial eyelid lesions and conjunctival cysts, removal of nonperforating foreign bodies, non-laser corneal debridement, removal of eyelashes, and probing/dilation/irrigation of tear drainage structures
surgery_definition.quote: does not include the use of surgery or injections in the treatment of eye diseases except for the use of the following types of in-office minor surgical procedures: (a) non-laser removal, destruction or drainage of superficial eyelid lesions and conjunctival cysts; (b) removal of nonperforating foreign bodies from the cornea, conjunctiva and eyelid; (c) non-laser corneal debridement, culture, scrape or anterior puncture, not including removal of pterygium, corneal biopsy or removal of corneal neoplasias; (d) removal of eyelashes; and (e) probing, dilation, irrigation or closure of the tear drainage structures of the eyelid

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: removal of nonperforating foreign bodies from the cornea, conjunctiva and eyelid

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: may administer epinephrine auto-injections to counter anaphylaxis

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: optometrists qualified and certified by the board may prescribe or administer all pharmaceutical agents for the diagnosis and treatment of disease of the eye or adnexa

value: Certification for use of pharmaceutical agents
specialty_certification_types.quote: The board shall issue certification for the use of pharmaceutical agents as set forth in Subsection A of this section to optometrists currently licensed by the board

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: The course shall constitute a minimum of twenty hours of instruction in clinical pharmacology, including systemic pharmacology as applied to optometry

telemedicine_authorized.quote: a health care provider from using telehealth in accordance with the provisions of the New Mexico Telehealth Act [Chapter 24, Article 25 NMSA 1978] for ocular diseases

contact_lens_prescription_expiration_yea.quote: indicate a specific date of expiration, which shall be twenty-four months from the date of the prescription, unless, in the professional opinion of the prescriber, a longer or shorter expiration date is in the best interests of the patient

spectacle_prescription_release_required.quote: refusing, after a request, to provide a patient a copy of the patient's eyeglasses prescription, if the prescription is not over one year old

patient_record_retention_years.quote: The request shall be in writing and signed by the patient, and shall be retained in the patient's file for at least five years

retired_license_status_available.quote: An optometrist who intends to retire from the practice of optometry shall notify the board in writing before the expiration of the optometrist's license, and the secretary-treasurer of the board shall acknowledge the receipt of the notice and record it. If within a period of five years from the year of retirement the optometrist desires to resume practice, the optometrist shall notify the board in writing, and, upon giving proof of completing refresher courses prescribed by rules of the board and the payment of any required fees, the license shall be restored to the optometrist in full effect
